history.summary: Freehold 1,259sqft 3BR at De Royale, D12 Balestier/Toa Payoh fringe, $2.49M / $1,977 PSF. Has a strong 5.68%/yr resale CAGR but on only 13 transactions, a weak score_1000 of 419, and is over 1km from the nearest MRT.
history.rating_rationale: Resale-only CAGR of 5.68%/yr is attractive but rests on just 13 URA transactions, so it is indicative not bankable. Asking $1,977 PSF is ~4% above the $1,904 median. The biggest drag is location: 1.08km / 13-min walk to Toa Payoh MRT is poor for a 3BR at $2.49M, and the arena record (220-327-22, Elo 1071, score 419) reflects below-average competitiveness. Freehold tenure and a useful 3BR size hold it at Neutral.
red_flags: 1.08km (13-min walk) to nearest MRT — weak connectivity for the price
Strong CAGR but only 13 transactions — low reliability
$2.49M sits above the deepest 3BR buyer-pool band; weak score_1000 (419)
catalysts: Balestier/Toa Payoh rejuvenation and city-fringe location
